title: Clinical Trial of TQB3702 Tablets in Subjects With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE)
off: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Phase II Clinical Trial Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of TQB3702 Tablets in Patients With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: TQB3702 is a selective kinase inhibitor. This is a Phase II clinical study aimed at evaluating the efficacy and safety of TQB3702 tablets in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus.

arms.d: Administer orally on an empty stomach, once daily, for 24 consecutive weeks.
Administer orally on an empty stomach, once daily, for 24 consecutive weeks. Placebo was administered orally once a day for 24 weeks.
Placebo was administered orally once a day for 24 weeks.
